parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Description of the release when creating a release.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Sets if the release is a draft or not. (boolean). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of release when creating a release.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The GitHub account password for the user. Mutually exclusive with token.

parameters.name: prerelease
parameters.description: Sets if the release is a prerelease or not. (boolean). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag name when creating a release. Required when using action=create_release.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target of release when creating a release.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for authenticating. Mutually exclusive with password.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The GitHub account that owns the repository.

examples:
- name: Get latest release of a public repository
  community.general.github_release:
    user: ansible
    repo: ansible
    action: latest_release

- name: Get latest release of testuseer/testrepo
  community.general.github_release:
    token: tokenabc1234567890
    user: testuser
    repo: testrepo
    action: latest_release

- name: Get latest release of test repo using username and password
  community.general.github_release:
    user: testuser
    password: secret123
    repo: testrepo
    action: latest_release

- name: Create a new release
  community.general.github_release:
    token: tokenabc1234567890
    user: testuser
    repo: testrepo
    action: create_release
    tag: test
    target: master
    name: My Release
    body: Some description

return_values.name: tag
return_values.description: Version of the created/latest release. Returned: success Sample: "1.1.0"
